nodes_add.name: Swami Niranjanananda Saraswati
nodes_add.note: Satyananda's successor; took over the running of the Bihar School of Yoga, Munger, in 1988. Birth year not verified in this batch.

nodes_add.name: Swami Akhandananda Saraswati (Mangrove Mountain)
nodes_add.note: Sent by Satyananda c. 1974 to oversee the Mangrove Mountain ashram, NSW; arrested 1989 on child sexual abuse charges and sentenced that year to 2 years 4 months (Royal Commission Case Study 21). Distinct from other monks of the same name.

nodes_update.name: Swami Satyananda Saraswati
nodes_update.note: Born Almora 25 Dec 1923; Sivananda's disciple from 1943, sannyasa 12 Sept 1947; Bihar School of Yoga, Munger, 1964; yoga nidra; handed over to Niranjanananda 1988; Rikhia from Sept 1989; died 5 Dec 2009.

edges_upsert.note: Came to the ashram 1943; sannyasa 12 September 1947; sent out 1956; Bihar School of Yoga, Munger, 1964.
Successor; took over the Bihar School of Yoga when Satyananda left Munger in 1988. Initiation year not verified.
Sent c. 1974 to oversee the Mangrove Mountain ashram; the Royal Commission (Case Study 21, 2016) found Satyananda had overarching authority there.

glossary.def: Yogic sleep. A guided practice done lying down, in which attention is led through the body, the breath and images while the practitioner stays aware at the edge of sleep; systematised by Swami Satyananda.
A resolve or intention. In yoga nidra, a short personal resolution repeated at the start and end of the practice.
Placing. A tantric rite in which mantras are placed, by touch or attention, on parts of the body.
Lock. A hatha yoga technique of contracting the throat, abdomen or pelvic floor to hold and direct the breath and energy.

satyananda: Born 25 Dec 1923 Almora; came to Sivananda 1943; sannyasa 12 Sept 1947 on the Ganges; sent out 1956; IYFM 1962 Rajnandgaon; BSY Munger 1964; APMB 1969; Yoga Nidra 1976; handed over 1988; Rikhia Sept 1989; died 5 Dec 2009; successor Niranjanananda; two witnesses alleged abuse by Satyananda, treated as out of scope and untested, no finding (citing RC report pp. 29-31) -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satyananda_Saraswati

Hearing 2-10 Dec 2014, Sydney; oral submissions 29 Apr 2015; scope: ashram's response 1974-2014 to allegations against Akhandananda -> https://www.childabuseroyalcommission.gov.au/case-studies/case-study-21-satyananda-yoga-ashram

Akhandananda oversaw the ashram from about 1974; arrested 1989, sentenced 1989 to 2 years 4 months; 11 survivors, ten women; no child protection policy 1975-1989; Survivor Support Pack 2014 probably developed without consulting survivors; BSY 'did not properly prioritise the welfare of survivors', focused on reputation -> https://www.childabuseroyalcommission.gov.au/media-releases/report-satyananda-yoga-ashram-released

Report released September 2016 (article 15 Sept 2016); ashram directors apologised -> https://www.sbs.com.au/language/hindi/hi/article/swami-akhandananda-saraswati-sexually-abused-and-raped-children-at-australias-oldest-yoga-ashram-royal-commission-finds/0cokb9v9d

Report title and date April 2016; Satyananda sent Akhandananda c. 1974; Akhandananda his chief disciple in Australia -> https://pdfroom.com/books/the-response-of-the-satyananda-yoga-ashram-at-mangrove-mountain/PXn2G3Zj2xV

Commission concluded Satyananda had 'overarching authority' at the ashram; BSY statement 'did not refer to' Satyananda's alleged conduct; BSY first distanced itself; Mangrove Yoga compensation payments -> https://yogaaustralia.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/RC-Case-Study-21.pdf
